name: SourceWizard
title: Templates/Platform/Create/SourceWizard
summary: A creation wizard that starts a resource from a code source and deploys it: the creation header, a Stepper rail that only lets you go back, the form column, and a footer with Back and the primary action that disappears while a step is answered by a click. It opens on Where it runs, a centred chooser of the service the project deploys to, six at a time with a search, an inline Create Service row and a way to continue without one; then a card of three methods (Import from Git, Sync with the CLI, Start from a template), each of which declares the remaining steps on the rail. The source, repository, target and configure steps of each method, and the provisioning and success screens (DeploymentFlow and DeploySuccess), are not plotted here. Built from `PageHeader`, `GlobalHeader`, `Stepper`, `Field`, `Input`, `Button`, `Card` and `Item`.

variants.name: Method
variants.summary: service-01 chosen: the page heading appears over How do you want to start?, a flush card of the three methods with a chevron each, and only Back in the footer, since picking a method is the answer.
